'''Currency converters''' were miniature [[Computer/Legends|computer]] systems that could be used to accurately inform the owner about [[Currency/Legends|currency]] conversions rates. [[Bank of the Core/Legends|Bank of the Core]] manufactured the [[GCC-1000]] currency converter.
